title: Staged exposure visuals and fallback flow screens for rollouts
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact set of onboarding and quickstart visuals that demonstrate progressive rollout strategies (staged exposure, canary sampling, A/B splits) and the fallback policy behavior (automatic downgrade to compatible model variant, region fallback, and manual pinning). These assets will be used in the Console quickstart, in the onboarding email sequence, and the docs quickstart gallery. We need a tight set of artboards (desktop + mobile) plus a short annotated flowsheet for engineers and PMs. Outcomes: 1) Visual language for 'exposure %' controls and live traffic preview, 2) Clear fallback state illustrations and microcopy, 3) A/B split UX that shows live metrics overlay (latency/cost/quality), 4) A handoff bundle with Figma link, SVG exports, and localized copy variants.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with 12 artboards: initial, canary ramp (4 incremental exposures), full-release, A/B split, fallback triggered, fallback resolved, manual pin modal (desktop+mobile)
Annotated specs for spacing, color tokens, and components delivered to engineering (token table + CSS snippets)
Exported PNGs and vector SVGs in assets folder with naming convention: rollout_<state>_<breakpoint>.svg/png
Onboarding copy approved by PM and Localization: English + 3 locale variants (es, fr, de)
Design review sign-off from PM (Liam O'Connor) and Eng owner (Ethan Chen) recorded in comments
deliverables: PNG and SVG export set (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Assets zip with layered source files for illustration team
Annotated flow PDF for engineers and PMs
Quickstart single-page screenshot deck for docs
assets_required: icons: traffic-split, pin, fallback, warning, success
illustrations: low-key gradient set for states (canary, control, fallback)
component mockups: exposure slider, percentage badge, live-metrics mini-chart
short animated GIFs: canary ramp, fallback auto-switch
mockup_states: Initial: 'Pin version' modal empty state with tooltip
Canary step 1: 1% exposure active, live preview shows small traffic dot
Canary step 2: 5% exposure, latency metric appears in overlay
Canary step 3: 25% exposure with A/B chart callouts
Full release: 100% traffic with green badge
A/B split: two variants 50/50 with per-variant metrics
Fallback triggered: yellow banner, automatic downgrade to compatible-variant, daily impact estimate
Fallback resolved: blue toast + timeline entry
copy_snippets: Onboarding header: 'Rollouts let you safely evolve model behavior with staged exposure.'
Canary tooltip: 'Start small. Observe latency, quality, and cost before ramping.'
Fallback banner: 'Traffic automatically routed to a compatible variant due to runtime error. No action required.'
Pin modal CTA: 'Pin this release for stable traffic (will bypass automated rollouts)'
A/B insight card: 'Variant B shows 12% fewer hallucinations in your test prompts.'
accessibility_considerations: Color contrast: ensure >=4.5:1 for all text overlays on metric chips
Keyboard focus states for the exposure slider and pin modal
Provide text-only equivalents for animated GIFs and charts for screen readers
Avoid conveying meaning with color alone (use icons and labels)
localization_requirements: Source copy in English, placeholders for es, fr, de
Allow expansion: design components should accommodate +30% string length
Right-to-left note: confirm layout integrity for potential ar locale in follow-up
handoff_checklist: Export SVGs and PNGs with 2x and 3x variants
Upload artboard slices to Drive and update Figma release tag
Add token mapping table with color, spacing, and typography references
Record a 10-min walkthrough video and attach to PR
Confirm engineering acceptance criteria and sign-off comment
